description: Post-1.0 Phase 29 — 1.0.x hotfix lane: versioning policy, CI hotfix job, Play staged rollout %. Schema 20 stays frozen; deploy/tag remain manual.

notes: Hotfix = bump patch only (1.0.1 → 1.0.2) and always +1 versionCode
Keep schemaVersion 20; do not change tutorial advanceOn / entitlement ids
Re-record starter-line fixtures only when sim/content behavior changes
storeRelease (v1.0.0-store) stays the Phase 18 public cut baseline

haltCriteria: Startup crash rate above Play bad-behavior threshold
ANR spike on onStop checkpoint / low-memory path
IAP purchase or restore failure rate for license testers
Widespread save corruption reports (AtomicFile / Recover previous surge)
stagedRollout.consolePath: Play Console → Fish Shopping → Production → Release → Staged rollout
stagedRollout.note: Hotfixes start at 10% (tighter than Phase 18's 20% first public cut).

ci.note: workflow_dispatch only — bump RELEASE_PIN first, then run hotfix job to cut AAB + mapping.

checklist: Identify hotfix scope (crash/ANR/IAP/save) — no schema break
Bump RELEASE_PIN versionName patch + versionCode; keep schemaVersion 20
Update listing-copy whatsNew / whatsNewVersion to match pin
npm run hotfix:validate && full CI content-and-parity green
Run workflow_dispatch android-hotfix (or android-release) for AAB + mapping
Upload to Play production staged rollout at 10%
Cut tag v1.0.{patch} when full rollout is healthy
manualCommands: gh workflow run CI -f confirm_pin_bumped=true -f rollout_step=canary
